prompt: On category pages, changing a filter dims the grid and says "Updating…" while the new products load, but changing "Sort by" does nothing visible for most of a second and then the order suddenly jumps. Users think the dropdown is broken. Make sorting show the same pending state.

truth.cause: SortControl calls router.push directly instead of the CatalogNavigation navigate helper, so the navigation runs in Next's internal transition and the shared useTransition isPending that CatalogResults reads never becomes true; React keeps showing the stale grid without an indicator.
truth.summary: Navigate through useCatalogNavigation().navigate so the push runs inside the shared startTransition and isPending drives the Updating state.

referenceFix.find:
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'

referenceFix.replace:
import type { CatalogQuery, SortOrder } from '../../lib/data/types'
import { useCatalogNavigation } from './catalog-navigation'
onChange={(event) => navigate(catalogHref(query, { sort: event.target.value as SortOrder }))}
